reason: Regie footbridge, metro pavilion, water tower, Basarab railings, fountains, facades
method: Round 3 (range 9824fd56..2b1a2511). Every atlas pose was rendered at 9824fd56, at 03aec30a (the master merge of load-time commits, before the round-3 work) and at 2b1a2511, with the same tool and conditions (game images only). The merge was checked first: 9824fd56 vs 03aec30a has no structural change in any of the 865 poses of the eight districts (no blurred difference at the 30/255 level survives a 5 px erosion; single-pixel maxima equal run-to-run JPEG noise), so the identical-output claim holds from above. Round-3 changes were ranked between the 03aec30a and 2b1a2511 renders (vegetation masked) and every ranked pose was compared by eye (published | 03aec30a | 2b1a2511, same pixels). Kept: new or changed structures, water areas, building heights and material class (glass vs masonry). Not counted: parked cars, tree crowns, median surfaces and re-rolled colours of procedural or background boxes. Every kept image was inspected at full size.

rejected.reason: only a roof / facade colour of a procedural or background box differs (re-rolled tint), no geometry or material-class change

notRetaken: Every other pose: no visible change between the 03aec30a and 2b1a2511 renders at the same pose, or only the differences listed under rejected.
